# NEW 2026-11-22 v17.5 Reactive World Engine 1.0 — Module 17.5-D: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_react_kernel_yearly) (oe_react_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v175_reactive_engine.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# O(1) zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration.
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_react_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_react_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_react_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_react_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_react_yearly_runs } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_react_yearly_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_react_yearly_runs add = 1 }
		}
		oe_react_seasonal_waves = yes
	}
}

# Global/carrier scope. Evaluates annual maritime sea-raider & steppe free-company waves
# ONLY for eligible realms (human players + major/regional powers), never spawning unstable army countries.
oe_react_seasonal_waves = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			oe_react_is_eligible_realm = yes
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_react_wave_country
		# 1. Seasonal Wokou / Barbary Sea Raiders wave (coastal realms)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1365
				oe_react_is_coastal_realm = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_raiders }
				OR = {
					any_port_in_country = {
						sea_zone ?= {
							area ?= {
								any_privateer_in_area = {
									NOT = { owner = scope:oe_react_wave_country }
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						at_war = yes
						num_of_ports >= 5
						current_year >= 1380
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_raiders years = 22 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.15
		}
		# 2. Anti-Piracy Patrol Expedition triumph follow-up
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_react_mod_coastal_patrol
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_patrol_triumph }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_patrol_triumph years = 20 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.16
		}
		# 3. Seasonal Steppe & Frontier Free Company wave (wartime realms)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1355
				at_war = yes
				war_exhaustion >= 3
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_free_company }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_free_company years = 22 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.17
		}
		# 4. Grand Free Company charter follow-up
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_react_mod_free_company_contract
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_charter_company }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_charter_company years = 20 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.18
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) road construction milestone counter -> fires oe_react.8 once per 15y.
oe_react_track_road_progress = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_road_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_road_count value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_react_road_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_react_road_count
			var:oe_react_road_count >= 3
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_road }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_road_count value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_road years = 15 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.8
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) urban building milestone counter -> nudges capital prosperity & triggers oe_react.8 if ready.
oe_react_track_building_progress = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_bldg_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_bldg_count value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_react_bldg_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_react_bldg_count
			var:oe_react_bldg_count >= 6
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_bldg_boom }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_bldg_count value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_bldg_boom years = 15 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			capital = { change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_road } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_road years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.8
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Handles failed parliament session cleanly without spamming events.
oe_react_handle_parliament_deadlock = {
	add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_react_mod_parl_deadlock years = 5 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = {
			at_war = yes
			war_exhaustion >= 4
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_react_cd_battle_shock }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_react_cd_battle_shock years = 12 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_react.4
	}
}

# Country scope. Reduces hostile privateer power across sea zones bordering our ports.
oe_react_suppress_hostile_privateers = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_react_patrol_country
	every_port_in_country = {
		sea_zone ?= {
			area ?= {
				every_privateer_in_area = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owner = scope:oe_react_patrol_country }
					}
					change_privateer_power = -0.15
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Safely creates & hires a timed 5-year mercenary Free Company at capital
# (zero unstable army-type countries spawned).
oe_react_spawn_free_company = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		create_mercenary = {
			name = oe_react_frontier_free_company
			home = capital
			categories = {
				army_heavy_infantry = 4
				army_light_cavalry = 2
			}
			cost_multiplier = 0.25
			save_scope_as = oe_react_free_company_band
			months = 60
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_react_free_company_band }
			hire_mercenary = scope:oe_react_free_company_band
		}
	}
}
